title: An Audited Decision Is Not A Transferable Policy
summary: A map separating decision audit, learning admission, pairwise comparability, transfer conditions, non-transfer findings, bounded reuse, and receiving-authority decision.
map_question: What must be reviewed before a lesson from one audited decision can inform another institution or operating context?
interpretation_boundary: Audit does not establish generality. Similar labels do not establish comparability. A transferable practice does not carry the original authority, and reuse requires a new accountable decision.

nodes.label: Independent Phase 75 decision audit
nodes.note: No independently audited Phase 75 decision exists.

nodes.label: Institutional-learning admission
nodes.note: Decision, implementation, outcome, harm, distribution, context, challenge, and receipt remain intact.

nodes.label: Second admitted audited decision
nodes.note: A pair cannot open without two admitted cases.

nodes.label: Comparable questions and intervention classes
nodes.note: Shared labels do not establish the same decision or mechanism.

nodes.label: Authority, context, population, and baseline
nodes.note: The receiving conditions and affected groups are explicit.

nodes.label: Measures, time, fidelity, and dependencies
nodes.note: Evidence compatibility and implementation differences are reviewed.

nodes.label: Harms, failures, distribution, and exceptions
nodes.note: Unfavorable evidence and non-transfer conditions cannot be dropped.

nodes.label: Bounded transfer or non-transfer finding
nodes.note: The finding states what travels, what does not, and why.

links.note: No audited decision is available for admission.
Measurement and implementation must also align.
Adverse and distributional evidence remains binding.

what_this_map_supports: Fourteen learning-admission gates and sixteen pairwise transfer gates.
Explicit transfer conditions, exceptions, and non-transfer findings.
A new accountable decision in every receiving context.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish an audited case, comparable pair, general lesson, precedent, best practice, or reusable policy.
It does not transfer authority, liability, safeguards, implementation capacity, or outcome expectations.
It does not create a score, ranking, portfolio conclusion, or stage advance.
next_records_needed: Two admitted learning dossiers with complete adverse and context records.
A pairwise comparability receipt and a separate receiving-authority reuse decision.
